profile_text.body:
Remind describes itself as a communication platform for teachers and for organizations outside of K-12 schools and districts, including youth organizations, sports programs, and nonprofits. According to its site, K-12 schools and districts are served by ParentSquare. The platform offers two-way communication for everyone in a learning or community group, with oversight and controls such as access to message history logs. The site also presents testimonials from users, including a community college and a district that says Remind became one of its primary tools for communication among parents and district leadership.

The company's tracked product is listed as Remind, in the Education and Research AI category, with a note that it was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified, and that AI features are not verified. Its stated use is class and school messaging, for teachers and families. Student age and privacy are not verified. Pricing is listed as Remind Chat free, with Remind Hub paid by quote, attributed to a third party.

No lawsuits, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers appear in the available facts.
